stem: What does this stage direction suggest about Grandpa?
instruction:
Read this stage direction from the play.

[Cara sands the wood, and Grandpa hums happily as he works on replacing the cracked piece.]

options.label: F
options.text: He is good at repairing rocking chairs.

options.label: H
options.text: He has the tools needed to make repairs to the chair.

options.label: J
options.text: He is glad that someone is helping him repair the chair.
